title: Paper accepted to IDC 2025
summary: A paper led by Zinan Zhang was accepted to the 24th ACM Interaction Design and Children Conference (IDC 2025).
details: Dangerous Playgrounds: Child Players’ Encounters with Design-Mediated Risks on User Generated Game Platforms and Their Safety Practices — Zinan Zhang, Xinning Gui, Junnan Yu, Sunhye Bai, and Yubo Kou
